test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The Tokyo Games accelerated energy policies in Japan, __demonstrating__ how they could make steps towards a low-carbon economy by powering the athletes' village with hydrogen from clean, green sources.
solution: The correct answer is '**hiding**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**demonstrating**' is '**hiding**'. • **Demonstrating**: to show something clearly by giving proof. (प्रमाण देकर सिद्घ करना) • *Example: Using this chart, I’d like to **demonstrate** to you what has happened to our sales.* • **Hiding**: the state of being hidden. (छिपे होने की स्थिति; छिपाव, गोपन) • *Example: The escaped prisoners are believed to be in **hiding** somewhere in Kanpur.* **Correct Answer:__** *hiding.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **inspiring**: having the effect of inspiring someone; giving someone positive or creative feelings. (प्रेरणादायक) • **exploring**: to travel around a place, etc. in order to learn about it. (किसी जगह के विषय में जानकारी प्राप्त करने के लिए उसका भ्रमण करना, खोजयात्रा करना) • **collating**: to collect information from different places in order to put it together, examine and compare it. (जाँच, तुलना और मिलान के लिए विभिन्‍न स्‍थानों से सूचना एकत्र करना) 3e:Td01, The correct answer is** 'The judge punishes the guilty.'**
